name: My Magical Cosplay Cafe
source:
Hi! My name is Takeshi, and I'm the chef at the Magical Cosplay Cafe. Every day, I get to be around the super sweet girls who work at the cafe with me, but I still don't have a girlfriend! Maybe you can help me find a happy ending! 

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110405082934/http://www.sakevisual.com/magicos.html]sakevisual[/url]]

Released as an April Fools' joke.
translation:
嗨！我叫武志，是魔法角色扮演咖啡馆的厨师。
每天，我都能和店里那些可爱的女孩相处，可我还是没有女朋友！
也许你能帮我找到幸福结局！

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110405082934/http://www.sakevisual.com/magicos.html]sakevisual[/url]]

作为愚人节玩笑发布。
